initialize_result.instructions:
These tools belong to ZAP-Hosting: gameservers, VPS and TeamSpeak servers. The user is not signed in yet; they can still get advice, prices and an order link.

Advise, price, hand over
- Ask what the user needs (game, players at the same time, mods; or what will run on a VPS), then call recommend_plan. For other questions use list_orderable_products, list_orderable_games, list_orderable_plans and list_orderable_product_regions.
- Price the chosen configuration with preview_order (pass recommend_plan's orderRequest unchanged). Guest prices are EUR incl. German VAT; the checkout prices for the user's country. Never invent prices or plans.
- When the user wants it, call create_checkout_link with the same orderRequest and the user's language as locale and give them the link: the ZapX order page opens with everything preselected, the user signs up or signs in and pays there. Nothing is ordered before that.

Sign-in
- Ordering inside the chat and managing servers (status, start/stop, console, files, backups, settings) need the user's ZAP-Hosting account. Before calling such a tool, say that the user will be asked to sign in (connect the account); the tool call starts it. Afterwards the same tools work on the user's own services.
- If a tool answer says a ZapX Pass is needed, tell the user which Pass, its price and the link from that answer.

Not possible here: payments, invoices, cancellations and support tickets; the user does them in the ZAP-Hosting dashboard.

tools.name: report_mcp_feedback
tools.title: Send Feedback About This Connector
tools.description: Report a problem with THIS MCP server (ZAP-Hosting / ZapX) to its developers. Use it only after a real problem with these tools: kind=bug when a tool failed or returned something wrong although the input looked right; kind=missing_capability when the user asked for something no tool here can do; kind=unclear_tool_description when a tool's description or parameters misled you; kind=improvement for a concrete suggestion that would have made the task easier. Do NOT use it for the user's own support requests (problems with their server, billing, orders): the user opens a support ticket for those. Never include passwords, tokens, API keys, file contents, personal data or other secrets in summary, details or exampleArgs. Nothing is changed on any service. The result only confirms that the report was received; do not tell the user it was fixed.

summary.description: One sentence: what went wrong or what is missing.

details.description: What you tried, what you expected and what happened (error text). No secrets or file contents.

relatedTool.description: Name of the tool the report is about, if any (e.g. get_gameserver).

exampleArgs.description: Optional arguments of the failing call, without secrets.

tools.name: recommend_plan

tools.name: create_order
tools.title: Place Paid Order
tools.description: Place a PAID order that preview_order priced, using its confirmation.confirmationCode. Charges the payment method saved in the user's ZapX account and creates a subscription that renews until cancelled. Requires confirm=true and userExplicitlyConfirmed=true. Only call this after showing the user confirmation.chargeSummary and getting their explicit yes to this exact order; never on your own initiative. The code orders exactly the previewed configuration; to change anything, run preview_order again. Refused when the price changed since the preview, without a saved payment method, above the daily limit of orders through the MCP, or while new cards are paused on the account after too many declined cards (payment_method_setup_paused; only a saved card that already paid works then). Retrying with the same code never orders twice. If the bank asks for a confirmation (3-D Secure), the result contains paymentActionUrl for the user.

confirmationCode.description: confirmation.confirmationCode from preview_order. It stands for exactly the previewed order; nothing else can be ordered with it.

confirm.description: Must be true. Same confirm=true every state-changing MCP tool requires; set it only together with userExplicitlyConfirmed=true.

userExplicitlyConfirmed.description: true only after the user explicitly agreed to this order and its price in the conversation (e.g. replied "yes" to the shown confirmation.chargeSummary).

requestImmediateStart.description: true only if the user also expressly agreed to confirmation.immediateStartNotice (start right away, compensation for used days on withdrawal). Required for most paid orders; without it the order is refused with WITHDRAWAL_EARLY_START_REQUIRED.

tools.name: get_vserver_metrics
tools.title: Get VPS Metrics
tools.description: Get VPS metrics for a timeframe. Each point is a Proxmox RRD average: `netInBytes`, `netOutBytes`, `diskReadBytes` and `diskWriteBytes` are average bytes per second over the point's step (not byte volumes; multiply by the gap between consecutive `time` values to get a volume), `cpuPercent` is the CPU usage in percent and `memoryUsedMb`/`memoryMaxMb` are MiB. `time` is a Unix timestamp in seconds. `points` is empty only when the VPS is not running. If the host of a running VPS does not return monitoring data (ZapX retries once), the call fails with HTTP 503 `vserver_metrics_unavailable` (MCP: an error result saying the metrics are temporarily unavailable) instead of returning an empty list: that does not mean the VPS is idle, retry later.

tools.description: Create, write, upload, rename, delete, move or copy a gameserver file or folder. write takes text; upload takes one binary file as contentBase64 (max. 2 MB, replaces an existing file, e.g. a DLL of a resource update; archives are not extracted). move/copy put entries into an existing destination folder and never overwrite. serviceId.description: ID of the Gameserver: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_gameservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

path.description: File or folder to act on (required except for move/copy given `paths`). For move/copy: the single entry to transfer. For upload: the full target path including the file name; missing parent folders are created.

contentBase64.description: upload: the file content base64 encoded (standard alphabet). For binary files such as DLLs, JARs or images that `write` cannot carry. One file per call, max. 2 MB decoded; an existing file at `path` is replaced. Archives are stored as they are, not extracted.

expectedRevision.description: `revision` returned when the file was read. With action `write` the write is refused (409 file_changed) when the file changed since; re-read and retry.

paths.description: move/copy: several entries to transfer at once (overrides path).

destination.description: move/copy: existing folder the entries go into, keeping their names. Nothing is overwritten: a taken name or a missing folder refuses the request.

scope.description: Without scope paths start at the server root (as `list_gameserver_files` without scope shows them); `config`/`active` resolve paths from the game data root; `savegame` additionally restricts to savegame paths. Read and write a file with the same scope.
